findings.title: E3's longest-path n*u tolerance is not an honest-error bound
findings.reproduction: CPU numerics.py: on the registered RMSNorm/float16/near_eps operands, ordinary nearest-even half arithmetic gives max error 0.0156582687232443 against tolerance 0.00843157814512645 (1.8571x). LayerNorm/bfloat16/near_eps gives 0.204845083463340 against 0.119538721863669. No engine output supplies either reference.
findings.argument: n*u*max|output| omits cancellation sensitivity of x-mean, absolute rounding at subnormal square/variance intermediates, and accumulation counts; n*u is also only a first-order gamma_n approximation. Adding a single final subnormal half-spacing cannot cover amplified intermediate errors. The census may label honest half arithmetic outside tolerance.
findings.suggested_fix: Derive per-operand forward/backward absolute bounds including conditioning, every subnormal intermediate and actual reduction/gradient accumulation, before G5; or label the frozen numbers as accuracy targets rather than rounding-derived bounds. Keep census measurement only.

findings.title: D4's preload does not isolate regression subprocess imports
findings.reproduction: CPU d4_child_probe.py preloads the pinned baseline package exactly like the staged child, then starts the same plain python -c import used by test_dlpack.py:603 with cwd=tool and inherited environment. Parent loads baseline pin 73ededa0..., subprocess exits 1 with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named tensor_cuda.
findings.argument: sys.path/sys.modules preload is process-local. test_dlpack.py:588 only copies os.environ for its subprocesses. No arm-specific PYTHONPATH/bootstrap is installed. Depending on caller environment those tests import no engine or an unpinned candidate/installed engine; matching failures in both arms can still satisfy the no-new-regression rule. D4's statement that subprocesses see candidate in both arms is environment-dependent.
findings.suggested_fix: Bind fresh Python subprocesses to the selected arm (for example prepend its package parent to inherited PYTHONPATH), verify and receipt their module origins/pins, and keep tests that inspect candidate source files explicitly separate from numerical arm comparisons.

findings.title: Power-of-two upstreams leave the bfloat16 final-cast decision unpinned
findings.reproduction: coverage_gaps.py: candidate and the M07 early-cast formula are bit equal on all five registered bfloat16 E2 cases. A bfloat16-only early-cast mutation would pass them. At stored x=0.0002994537353515625, g=0.30078125, p=3, early-cast error is 3.560529648893862e-10 > tolerance 3.161531656994043e-10; final-cast error is 1.0960832241835305e-10.
findings.argument: Multiplication by exact powers of two commutes with bfloat16 rounding over these normal exponent ranges. M07 is killed through float16 overflow, not through bfloat16 multiply-rounding behavior.
findings.suggested_fix: Add at least one non-power-of-two half/bfloat16 upstream witness and a bfloat16-only early-cast mutant, retaining a derived tolerance. The cited witness is a candidate.

findings.title: The OW=0 boundary is not isolated from OH refusal
findings.reproduction: coverage_gaps.py: hypothetical one-edit predicate (oh <= 0 || ow < 0) makes the same refusal on all five registered geometry classes. Input (0,1,6,2), kernel (3,3), stride (1,1), padding (0,0) gives OH=4, OW=0 and distinguishes it.
findings.argument: ow_only has OW=-2, while the only OW=0 witness trunc_gap also has OH=0. M11 changes both predicates and is killed by OH, and M12 removes OW entirely; neither pins the independent OW=0 decision.
findings.suggested_fix: Add OH>0, OW=0 refusals for all four public callers and a mutant that weakens only OW <= 0 to OW < 0.

findings.title: The reported reshape caller count is incorrect
findings.reproduction: census_scope.py finds 37 engine reshape calls on 32 source lines, plus 9 NumPy calls; the report says 30 engine callers. CALLER_CENSUS.md names and reasons about all 46 calls.
findings.argument: Several lines contain two reshape calls, and quant.py has two additional engine calls. All 37 engine calls retain results for previously valid nonnegative explicit shapes.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the count and retain an itemized call census, including quant.py:124 and :186 and multiple calls on the same line.
